modules.title: HTML Fundamentals
modules.description: This module covers the basics of HTML, including tags, attributes, and structure. Students will learn how to create a basic web page and understand the importance of semantic HTML. By the end of this module, students will be able to write clean and efficient HTML code.

modules.title: CSS Layouts
modules.description: This module covers the basics of CSS layout, including display types, positioning, and box models. It also introduces flexible boxes and grid layouts. Students will learn how to create responsive and mobile-first layouts.

modules.title: JavaScript Basics
modules.description: This module covers the fundamental concepts of JavaScript, including data types, variables, control structures, and functions.

modules.title: Responsive Design
modules.description: This module focuses on designing and developing websites that adapt to different screen sizes, orientations, and devices. Students will learn about media queries, flexible grids, and mobile-first design principles.

resources.title: Media queries
resources.summary: Media queries is a feature of CSS 3 allowing content rendering to adapt to different conditions such as screen resolution. It became a W3C recommended standard in June 2012, and is a cornerstone technology of responsive web design (RWD).

modules.title: Frontend Frameworks
modules.description: This module will cover popular frontend frameworks like React, Angular, and Vue.js. Students will learn about their architecture, components, and best practices for building scalable web applications.

modules.title: Back-end Development
modules.description: This module covers the fundamentals of back-end development, including server-side programming languages and frameworks.

modules.title: Database Management
modules.description: This module covers the fundamental concepts of database management, including data modeling, normalization, and querying. It also touches upon database design principles and tools. Students will learn how to create, maintain, and optimize databases for efficient data storage and retrieval.

resources.title: Data modeling
resources.summary: Data modeling in software engineering is the process of creating a data model for an information system by applying certain formal techniques. It may be applied as part of broader model-driven engineering (MDE) concept.

modules.title: API Integration
modules.description: This module focuses on integrating APIs into web applications, including API design, security, and testing.

modules.title: Security and Authentication
modules.description: This module covers the essential concepts of security and authentication in web development, including secure coding practices, password hashing, and user authentication protocols.

modules.title: Full-stack Development
modules.description: This module will cover the full stack development process, including front-end and back-end development. Students will learn how to integrate APIs, implement security measures, and authenticate users.
